question: Which owners have the most open heat issues this month?
text: The owners with the most open heat issues this month are Isthmus Edge Properties (demo) with 9 open issues and Prairie Rentals (synthetic) with 4 open issues. Isthmus Edge Properties (demo) has more than double the number of open heat issues compared to the next highest owner.
sql:
WITH ranked_owners AS (
  SELECT 
    o.owner_id,
    o.name AS owner_name,
    COUNT(r.report_id) AS open_heat_issues,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.report_id) DESC) AS rank
  FROM `fixit`.`gold`.`reports` r
  JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`properties` p ON r.property_id = p.property_id
  JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`owners` o ON p.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE r.status IN ('open','escalated')
    AND r.violation_category = 'HEAT'
    AND r.reported_at >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE)
    AND o.name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.name
)
SELECT owner_id, owner_name, open_heat_issues, rank
FROM ranked_owners
ORDER BY open_heat_issues DESC;
